name: 江湖救急-改
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE LANDSCAPE 4:3 game card illustration for 江湖救急-改 (Urgent Help from the Jianghu). Entirely new staging, no card frame, text, UI or watermark.

INPUTS: image1 is the USER'S AUTHORITATIVE Wu FACE AND EYE reference. Image2 is Wu's current COSTUME / ACCESSORIES reference only. Images3/4 are DRAWING STYLE references only (broad opaque brush portrait and economical dark-coat portrait). Do not copy reference poses, white backdrops, text or watermarks. The FACE must faithfully follow image1, especially its distinctive eyes; costume/hair must follow the stated current design rather than image1's wavy hair/longer skirt.

SCENE DESIGN: one immediate moment of EMERGENCY AID RECEIVED, communicated by gesture and symbolic objects rather than scenery. Wu in a dynamic three-quarter thigh-up close composition, torso turning toward the right, her nearer bare hand reaching into lower-right foreground, open palm upward receiving EXACTLY THREE simple paper/talisman-like rectangular sheets sweeping in from the right image edge. Sheets overlap slightly but all THREE remain clearly countable. They are blank physical symbols of fleeting support, NOT tiny printed trading cards or interface panels. A second person's SINGLE partly seen sleeve/hand at the FAR RIGHT EDGE may be shown releasing the three sheets toward her; only that assisting hand, no second face or whole person. Wu's OTHER hand stays close to her chest, relaxed and ready. Her quick responsive lean and light fang smile read as an agile heroine catching unexpected help; both bright eyes clear. This handoff creates a diagonal from unseen helper to her open receiving hand to her face. Long straight ponytail and loose black sleeves sweep opposite the arriving sheets. Do not repeat raised overhead arm, sword swing, glasses-adjusting, symmetrically spread arms or centered standing pose.

SYMBOLIC OBJECTS: the three sheets are rough solid-color rectangles, one muted pale cream, one subdued teal-gray, one pale dusty ochre, with irregular brushed edges and slight tapered motion marks. No drawings, writing, portraits, icons, numbers, frames or glowing glyphs on them. A few purposeful broken edges and ONE pale broad curved swipe connecting them suggest TEMPORARY borrowed help, not an explosion of magic particles. No sword needed in this card. No bandages, potion, healing cross or medkit; this card obtains three temporary cards rather than healing.

BACKGROUND: PURE SOLID alternating pale warm gray, muted teal-gray and deep blue-gray blocks; asymmetrical broad angled division supporting the handoff. An ABSTRACT background only. No town, buildings, forest, road, clouds, sky, horizon, ground, props or realistic environment. Leave a generous quiet light pocket behind the face and quiet dark area behind the pale papers. Support is a symbolic handoff, not an actual environmental scene.

WU IDENTITY: adult anime woman, silver-white LONG STRAIGHT HIGH PONYTAIL to hip area, straight bangs leaving both eyes visible. Black round goggles above forehead, BLACK ROSE and cobalt BLUE RIBBON at high ponytail ROOT. Black-gray off-shoulder short dress, LONG loose sleeves from below shoulder openings to gathered wrist cuffs; all front/side/back hems equally ABOVE KNEES with one narrow blue-star band ONLY along the hem. Bare hands, bare thighs. No blue stars on bodice or sleeves. Black ankle boots if in frame. No gloves, armor, wavy ponytail, long skirt/train, staff or sword.

FACE: directly reproduce image1's appealing recognisable youthful face, compact rounded cheeks/small chin, lively mischievous mouth and tiny pointed fang. Faithfully match the user's reference EYE SHAPES/SPACING: open bright cyan-turquoise irises, distinct dark pupils, dark tapered upper lids and a few clean outer lashes, white sclera contrast and sparse lower-lid accents. SAME gaze character and expression, not a generic pretty anime face, narrow sleepy eyes, doll face or soft vacant smile. A few selected crisp eye marks inside calm broad face planes; no dense iris detail, glossy lips or photoreal skin.

FINISH: VERY ROUGH HAND-PAINTED ANIME COLOR STUDY, conspicuously less finished than polished card splash art. LARGE opaque blunt brush swipes build whole hair locks, sleeve planes and skirt masses. Deliberately stop before detailing. A base color, ONE large shadow group and only a couple broad midtone strokes per region. Leave some loose structural sketch accents, rough broken brush endings and slight paint overlap misregistration, with large calm color interiors. Hair is 4–6 substantial coherent locks; no strand networks or pale fine scratches. Dress is a few connected near-black masses and broad gray fold planes; do not individually render every ruffle, tiny crease or fabric texture. Hands coherent but simple. FACE/EYES receive only the selective clarity necessary to match image1; rest stays coarse. Palette muted charcoal, ivory, cool grays and local cobalt/cyan eye and hem accents. Mostly decisive hard-edged shadows, matte paint. Roughness comes from FEWER WIDER PURPOSEFUL MARKS, not grain/noise, little chips, canvas filter, endless tiny triangles or random scratches. No glossy 3D, polished metal, airbrush gradients, bloom, rimlight, realistic materials, particle clouds, decorative clutter, typography or watermark.
direction: 粗手绘、纯色抽象背景、意象、独特接援分镜，脸眼忠实参考老板b8dee图；不测试
